issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, KENO column 452,280.82 (of governmental 559,984.69)
issues.issue: 452,280.82 of this line is printed in the Keno fund column and is most likely keno/lottery proceeds. It is 65% of governmental receipts, so it may deserve its own category (keno/lottery). The printed label is 'Other', so 'other' can be defended.
